prompt: On Python 3.14, annotations are evaluated lazily and a ClassVar that was never imported in the module shows up as a typing.ForwardRef object instead of a string. attrs then fails to recognise it as a class variable when using auto_attribs, so `cls_var: ClassVar[str]` (with ClassVar not imported) is turned into an attribute with no default and breaks construction. The private helper that decides whether an annotation is a ClassVar (attr._make._is_class_var) returns False for typing.ForwardRef('ClassVar[str]'). Expected: forward references that spell out ClassVar are treated as class variables, just like the equivalent string annotations.
setup: python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -q -e . pytest hypothesis pympler cloudpickle zope.interface
